title: AWS Summit Johannesburg
heading: All Aboard the MCP Train!
body: Ever wondered how some teams are building AI systems that are faster, cheaper, and more resilient?

Join me and I’ll walk you through the power of Model Context Platforms (MCP) and share why they’re becoming a game-changer. You’ll get insights on how MCP can boost your system’s efficiency, streamline workflows, and cut costs—plus, the challenges you need to watch out for.
Don’t miss out the chance to get on the MCP train! It could be the key in your AI strategy.
